referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Swiss electricity mix, from wind farm. Includes the operation of the wind farm with the necessary change of gear oil. 100MW wind farm, consisting of 2.3MW onshore turbines (conrete and steel towers) and 3.4MW onshore wind turbines. Model is based on the electricity production in Switzerland between 2020-2024, with a capacity factor of 19.7% (source: BFE 2025). Assumed lifetime is 25 years. Annual electricity production is 173 GWh, applying a capacity factor of 19.7%.
referenceFunction.name: Electricity, at wind farm

exchange.generalComment: (4,2,1,1,1,1,BU:3); Own calculation; number of turbines derived assuming 77% of installed power capactiy of 100 MW is covered with 2.3 MW onhsore wind turbines, divided by total electricity production over a life cycle of 25 years with an annual electricity production of 173 GWh; input calculated as (0.77 × 100 / 2.3) / (25 × 173 GWh)
